name: motif_merge_phoneme
description:
Merge a phoneme into another. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use only if the language has no contrast between the two phonemes; otherwise keep both, since the contrast cannot be recovered from the words afterwards (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs). Stages a merge of one phoneme into another: each spelling of the first becomes another way to write the second, and the first phoneme is removed from the inventory and from its natural classes. It refuses a spelling another phoneme has, a natural class the first phoneme alone fills, and a rule or environment that uses the first phoneme. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-merge-phoneme. Agent class: Draft.

source.description: Id of the phoneme to merge away.

target.description: Id of the phoneme that keeps its identity and gains the spellings.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
